label: C-Pop / Guofeng (Traditional Chinese Style) / Cinematic Ballad

cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, melancholic atmosphere that evokes deep introspection and historical weight.
cards.vocal: A single male vocalist delivers the performance with a clear, resonant tenor timbre.
cards.palette: A solo cello (or similar bowed string instrument) serves as the melodic anchor, introducing the main motif in the intro and weaving through the verses with expressive, legato phrasing.
